newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stock market returns to upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stock market returns to upward trend.

text.p: Moroccan stock market on Wednesday returned to its upward trend, pushed up by market blue chips including Societe Nationale d'Investissement, a bourse official said.
The all-share index rose 0.03 percent to close at 427.28 points.

"The market trades at 16 times the expected 1996 earnings, which is still below the equivalent 18.5 times figure registered in the same period last year," a Casablanca-based analyst said. SNI, one of the market's largest capitalisations, gained one dirham to close at 601 dirhams.

ONA Group, Morocco's largest conglomerate, jumped 10 dirhams to close at 450 dirhams. Brokers said the rise coincided with the announcement of ONA's sale of 20 percent in its Centrale Laitiere unit to France's Danone group.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, one of the market's liquid stocks, rose one dirham to 408 dirhams.

Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market's largest bank, remained high despite a drop of 20 dirhams compared with other stocks. It closed at 700 dirhams. The bourse traded volume was 28.4 million dirhams, up from 27 million on Tuesday. ($1= 8.7 dirhams)
